optimized_sql:
WITH ss AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_customer_sk,
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_ticket_number,
        ss_sold_date_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_moy = 4 AND d1.d_year = 1999
),
sr AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk,
        sr_item_sk,
        sr_ticket_number,
        sr_returned_date_sk
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d2.d_year = 1999
),
cs AS (
    SELECT 
        cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs_item_sk,
        cs_sold_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d3.d_year = 1999
)
SELECT 
    i_item_id, 
    i_item_desc, 
    s_store_id, 
    s_store_name, 
    MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit, 
    MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss, 
    MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON ss.ss_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AND ss.ss_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
